pkgmetadata.longdescription: rtk (Rust Token Killer) is a CLI proxy that sits in front of common commands and compresses their output before it reaches an LLM context. It ships filters for over a hundred tools - git, cargo, docker, npm, pytest, kubectl, the AWS CLI and more - applying smart truncation, grouping and deduplication to cut token usage while keeping the information that matters. Intended for use with AI coding agents.
